import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder
import warnings
import os

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data
train = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Extract features with correct naming (no underscores)
feature_cols = [col for col in train.columns if col not in ["id", "species"]]
X = train[feature_cols].values
y = train["species"].values
X_test = test[feature_cols].values

# Encode labels
le = LabelEncoder()
y_encoded = le.fit_transform(y)
class_names = le.classes_

# Stratified K-fold for OOF predictions
n_splits = 5
skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=n_splits, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
oof_probs = np.zeros((X.shape[0], len(class_names)))
test_probs = np.zeros((X_test.shape[0], len(class_names)))

# LightGBM parameters (based on successful previous runs)
params = {
    "objective": "multiclass",
    "num_class": len(class_names),
    "metric": "multi_logloss",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "num_leaves": 31,
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "feature_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "verbose": -1,
    "seed": 42,
    "n_jobs": -1,
}

# Perform cross-validation
for fold_idx, (train_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(skf.split(X, y_encoded)):
    X_tr, X_val = X[train_idx], X[val_idx]
    y_tr, y_val = y_encoded[train_idx], y_encoded[val_idx]

    train_data = lgb.Dataset(X_tr, label=y_tr)
    val_data = lgb.Dataset(X_val, label=y_val, reference=train_data)

    model = lgb.train(
        params,
        train_data,
        num_boost_round=1000,
        valid_sets=[val_data],
        callbacks=[
            lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50, verbose=False),
            lgb.log_evaluation(0),
        ],
    )

    oof_probs[val_idx] = model.predict(X_val)
    test_probs += model.predict(X_test) / n_splits

# Calculate validation log loss
val_logloss = log_loss(y_encoded, oof_probs)
print(f"Validation Log Loss: {val_logloss:.6f}")

# Create submission DataFrame
submission = pd.DataFrame(test_probs, columns=class_names)
submission.insert(0, "id", test["id"].values)

# Ensure correct column order matching sample submission
submission = submission[sample_sub.columns]

# Save submission
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

# Print final validation metric
print(f"Validation Log Loss: {val_logloss:.6f}")
